single_bottleneck: The first Host run-record update used bare JSON-style true/false tokens inside a PowerShell hashtable, so outcome serialization stopped before writing the formal outcome object.

reproduction.error: The term 'true' is not recognized as a cmdlet/function
reproduction.guest_side_effect: none; Guest run was already terminal and harvested

expected: Use PowerShell $true/$false values, serialize the outcome, then parse it back before dispatching another run.
minimal_change: Replace bare boolean literals with $true/$false in the Host bookkeeping script.
verification: harvest/outcome.json and run.json outcome parse as valid JSON and retain target fields as NOT_OBSERVED_DYNAMIC.
rollback: No Guest rollback required; this only affects Host run-record publication.
